verses.text: Ha in Pablo in tik, winhaj Silvano yet' winhaj Timoteo, sko tz'ib'ejb'at jun carta tik t'ayex ex iglesia ex t'a Tesalónica. Yik exxo ko Mam Dios yet' Kajalil Jesucristo. Ayokab' wach'k'olal yet' junk'olal t'a he kal ta'.
Skak' wal yuj diosal t'a Dios eyu'uj he masanil. Juntak el tzonh lesalwi, tzex ko nakoti.

Ha t'a yichanh ko Mam Dios sko nakoti to niwan tzex munlaj t'ay, yujto ix eyak' wal och t'a he k'o'ol. Sko nakoti to tzeyak' serwil Dios chi', yujto te xajan eyu'uj. Hanhejtona', tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, yujto anhej Kajal Jesucristo tzeyak'och yipok he k'o'ol.
Xajanab'il ex yuj Dios, yujto a sik'jinak exxo kaneli.

Ayik kek'nak kalel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'ayex, manh tonhejok komon lolonnak onh. Yujto a Yespíritu Dios ochnak ket'ok. Kojtak wal sik'lab'il to te yel jun ab'ix tik. Eyojtak paxi chajtil kutejnak ko b'eyb'al t'a he kal yuj he wach'il.

Ha exxo, ochnak ex ijan he b'eyb'alan ko b'eyb'al chi'. Ix he b'eyb'alan pax sb'eyb'al Kajal Jesús. Wach'chom niwan sya'elal ix eyab'i ayik ix he cha'an slolonel Dios, palta te tzalajk'olal ix he cha'a, yujto a Yespíritu Dios ix ak'an he tzalajk'olal chi'.
Yuj chi', ix he ch'oxel jun wach' b'eyb'al t'a masanil heb' ketcreyenteal t'a yol yik Macedonia chi' yet' t'a yol yik Acaya tik.

Eyu'uj ix pukaxb'at yab'ixal Kajal Jesús t'a junjun lugar. Ix laj yab' heb' aj Macedonia chi' yet' heb' aj Acaya to tzeyak' wal och Dios t'a he k'o'ol. Manhoknhej heb' ix ab'ani, ix laj yab' pax heb' ay t'a junjun lugar. Yuj chi', manhxo yowalilok a onh skalel eyab'ixal t'a skal heb' anima.

Yujto masanil mach wan yalan eyab'ixal to wach' ajnak onh he cha'ani ayik kek'nak t'ayex. Wan laj yalanpax heb' chajtil eyutejnak eyaktankan juntzanh eyak'nakoch he diosalok, ix ex och pax ijan eyak'an serwil Dios pitzan, haton jun Dios te yel.

Hanhejtona' syalanpax heb' to wan he tanhwan yemxul Yuninal Dios t'a satcha'anh, haton Jesús. Ha Dios ak'jinakxi pitzwok t'a skal heb' chamnak. Haton tzonh kolankanel t'a yol sk'ab' jun niwan ya'elal ol jawok yuj yowal sk'o'ol Dios.
